caption: The drawing depicts a brown cylindrical cup with a slightly flared rim positioned upright on a neutral background. The cup has a reddish-brown terracotta color, with subtle gradients showing light and shadow, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. On the outward surface of the cup, there are raised decorative reliefs: one appears to portray a seated figure next to a small table or pedestal, with another indistinct shape on the left side. The cup casts a bluish-grey shadow to the right and slightly behind it. The drawing is bordered by a faint rectangular outline, and in the bottom left corner, there is a small sketch of the cup along with measurement notations, drawn in a simple line style. The background is off-white with minimal detail apart from the primary object and the small sketch.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
